modalContent.title: Introduction to Oil Painting
modalContent.location: Eight minutes' drive north-west of Margaret River township between Bussell Highway and Caves Road in the beautiful, forested Burnside community.
modalContent.description:
Build the foundational skills to paint with confidence in this full-day Oil Painting workshop for beginners and those wanting to refine and expand their existing skill set.

Exploring simple composition and drawing to form the basis of our painting we move on to applying tonal values to create a monochromatic underpainting.

Observing the effects of light on our subject matter we translate value to colour, mixing to explore saturation and hue with attention to temperature and finally, application bringing it all together to arrive at a completed alla prima artwork.

A relaxed studio environment with a maximum four participants ensures generous individual guidance along with live demonstrations.

Apply knowledge gained from this introductory workshop and save by coupling a second day workshop in Still Life.

modalContent.title: Still Life Oil Painting
modalContent.location: Eight minutes' drive north-west of Margaret River township between Bussell Highway and Caves Road in the beautiful, forested Burnside community.
modalContent.description:
For those who have some experience or wish to expand on the knowledge gained from my Introduction to Oil Painting Workshop we add a further day, taking a deeper dive into painting a specially composed still life.

Focusing on intense contrast to create dramatic form and dimension we learn to capture the light, interpret values, apply temperature and colour theory to create your artwork.

A relaxed studio environment with a maximum four participants ensures generous individual guidance along with live demonstrations.

All workshop equipment and supplies provided. You will take away your painted canvas.

modalContent.title: Create Your Own Workshop
modalContent.description:
Julie-Ann can tailor a class to your requirements with a minimum of four participants.

If you're curious about stoking your artistic talent and have some time on your hands email her to start planning!
